title: Enzymatic Synthesis of Deoxyribonucleic Acid. I. Preparation of Substrates and Partial Purification of an Enzyme from Escherichia coli
lineage: University of Delhi hosted copy of Journal of Biological Chemistry 233, 163–170; DOI 10.1016/S0021-9258(19)68048-8. Full PDF cached; only specified passages inspected. Its 2017 download stamp is not the experiment date.

passages.note: p. 163: affiliation and receipt on 10 October 1957; opening rationale, assay/purification purpose, and stated reaction requirements inspected.
Opening paragraph: anchor “guided by the known enzymatic mechanisms”. The authors identify coenzyme chemistry as their experimental guide.
